Use cases
Push in CRM data
— Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the
REST API
.
Sync data out
— Stream changes with
webhooks
, query the
event log
, or pull
reporting metrics
and pipeline data into your BI tools, data warehouse, or design custom dashboards & reports.
Automate outreach
— Manage workflows with
sequences
or
bulk actions
, or send email/SMS programmatically.
Publish an integration
— Build for many Close customers with
OAuth
and get listed in the
integrations directory
.
Power AI agents
— Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the
MCP server
— no code required.
